title: Area of Triangles, Parallelograms and Trapeziums
summary: Cut and rearrange shapes into rectangles to discover (and never forget) their area formulas.

ib.note: Area of 2D shapes is MYP 2 Measurement

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Ch 6: Perimeter and Area
Earlier NCERT Ch 9: Perimeter and Area

objectives: I can find the area of parallelograms, triangles and trapeziums.
I can explain the formulas by rearranging shapes.
I can solve real area problems.
misconceptions: The slanted side is the height.
A triangle's area is base × height.
Shearing a shape changes its area.
